name: kicad-splitplane
description: Split a power layer into one continuous zone per net
description_full: On a board where several supplies share one inner power layer, kicad-splitplane computes exactly one continuous copper zone per net from the positions of its vias and through-hole pads, keeps foreign vias out of every zone and writes the zones into the open board as a single undo step. A preview shows the split before anything is written.
